# FarmXYZ

> FarmXYZ is a farm management platform for broiler poultry farms in Bangladesh, with thermal
> imaging and digital livestock tracking for poultry and cattle. The app is in Bangla by default,
> with English available.

FarmXYZ helps farmers run broiler batches from day one to sale. They record feed, medicine,
mortality, weight, expenses and sales for each batch, and see profit and loss per farm and per
batch.

Key facts:

- Website: https://farmxyz.web.app
- Sign-up: name, mobile number and password. No SMS verification.
- Pricing: paid subscription by bKash. Signed-in users can always view their own data. Adding or
  editing records needs an active subscription.
- Languages: Bangla (default) and English.

## Pages

- [Home](https://farmxyz.web.app/): product overview covering thermal imaging, poultry and
  cattle tracking, and how to get started
- [Sign up](https://farmxyz.web.app/signup): create an account
- [Log in](https://farmxyz.web.app/login): sign in to the farm dashboard
